lines.text: The root is Sign! Signal, signature.
Did you know? Sign is Latin for mark.
Signal: a mark that tells you something.
Quick quiz! Which means your own mark?
Signature! It means your own mark.

words.mean: a mark that tells you something
words.ex: There is no phone signal in the mountains.
We need your signature at the bottom of the form.
